title: THE HOST IS TOLD WHEN A TEAMMATE JOINS THE RAID
why: A teammate who pressed JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS just appeared beside the host with no word. The host now reads that teammate name is joining the raid when the answer goes out.
now: When your teammate joins the raid in progress, you are told by name.

edits.replacement:
if(!netSend(peer,m)) return 'lost';
  try{ say((netSeatName(peer.seat)||'Your teammate')+' is joining the raid.'); }catch(_ls){}   // v16.xx: the host hears who is coming
